name: Demo G13: Delete-Like Redline Pipe Route
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation using a disposable modeled pipe route: create the route, prove created model ids, delete those exact ids, prove absence, and write visual-gate evidence.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view and ordered model-space points where a short unconnected pipe route can be created and deleted safely.
success_criteria: A disposable pipe route is created through /revit/mep-route-workflow with created model ids.
The created route ids are visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
Native delete dry-run and apply effect evidence include every created pipe/fitting id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the created pipe/fitting ids.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The disposable pipe route is not created or returns no model ids.
Delete dry-run or apply omits any created pipe/fitting id from effect evidence.
The post-delete visible-element inventory still contains a created pipe/fitting id.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task covers delete-like pipe redlines using real model-write evidence, not annotation-only evidence.
All created pipe/fitting ids must be represented in delete effect evidence.
